title: Performance Marketing Agency in Charleston, SC
metaTitle: Performance Marketing Agency in Charleston, SC | TDM
metaDescription: Google, Meta and TikTok ads for Charleston businesses: visitor and wedding campaigns in feeder cities, local leads by neighbourhood, tracked to bookings.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) manages paid advertising for Charleston businesses on Google, Meta and TikTok, with budgets judged by bookings, leads and sales. Paid media in Charleston has two geographies. One is the list of cities your guests and wedding couples travel from. The other is the metro itself, where rivers, bridges and the I-26 commute decide how far a customer will go. We run each as its own campaign.

sections.heading: Reaching people who are not here yet
paragraphs: A hotel, inn, tour, restaurant group or wedding venue downtown sells mainly to people who live somewhere else. The useful campaign runs in their home cities while they are choosing dates, then narrows to phones physically in Charleston once they are deciding where to eat tonight or which harbour tour to take tomorrow. Your own reservation data shows which cities to start with.

Hotels and tour companies also find the online travel agencies bidding on their names. A modest brand campaign, paired with a booking page that is quicker than the platform's, often brings those reservations back to you direct.

Wedding advertising runs on a longer clock. A couple may see a venue on Instagram or Pinterest, visit the site several times and enquire weeks later. We track those enquiries over a long window, not by the last click.

sections.heading: Advertising to the metro
paragraphs: For a dentist, law firm or HVAC company, the customer is local and the map is awkward. A circle drawn around an address in Mount Pleasant takes in water, marsh and parts of the peninsula whose residents will not cross the bridge at five o'clock. We target the areas your customers really come from, such as Daniel Island, West Ashley, Park Circle, Summerville or Goose Creek, and write ads that name them.

Healthcare advertisers need extra care, because ad platforms restrict how health-related audiences can be targeted and what tracking may collect. We set up measurement for practices with those limits in mind.

Employers are a third group. The plants, the logistics firms around the port terminals and the hospital systems recruit constantly, and paid search and social reach technicians, drivers and nurses across Charleston, Berkeley and Dorchester counties.

sections.heading: What we run and manage
paragraphs: Campaigns sit in accounts that belong to you. We first agree a target cost per lead or return on ad spend based on your margins, then report against it.
bullets: Google Search, Performance Max, Shopping and YouTube campaigns.
Facebook and Instagram campaigns, from first view to booking or enquiry.
TikTok campaigns using short video produced by our media team.
Retargeting for people who checked dates, started a booking or opened an enquiry form.
Landing pages built by our developers, with call, form and booking tracking tested before launch.

sections.heading: Timing: festivals, quiet weeks and storms
paragraphs: Demand in Charleston bunches in spring and autumn, and around weeks such as the wildlife exposition in February, the wine and food festival, the Bridge Run and Spoleto. Rooms and tables on those dates tend to sell without help, so advertising money usually works harder on the weeks either side, on midweek stays and in the hottest months.
From late summer a named storm can stop travel bookings within a day. We keep a pause plan and a reopening message ready so that spend does not run while nobody is booking.

items.title: Direct bookings for stays and tours
items.text: Search and social ads in the cities guests travel from, leading to your own booking page and not a platform's.

items.title: Wedding enquiries
items.text: Visual campaigns for venues, planners and photographers, measured by qualified enquiries for open dates.

items.title: Local leads by neighbourhood
items.text: Calls and forms for clinics, law firms and trades, targeted to the parts of the metro each office can serve.

items.title: Recruitment
items.text: Job campaigns for manufacturers, logistics firms and healthcare employers competing for the same skilled people.

presence: A member of our team is based in South Carolina, outside the city of Charleston, and campaign set-up, management and reporting are handled remotely by the wider TDM team, inside ad accounts you own and can open at any time.

faqs.q: Does TDM have a paid ads team in Charleston?
faqs.a: No. A member of our team is based in South Carolina, and campaigns are built and managed remotely, with regular calls and full access to the accounts for you.

faqs.q: Which cities should a Charleston hotel or tour company advertise in?
faqs.a: Start with the places your existing guests come from, which your reservation records will show. Many visitors drive in from elsewhere in the Carolinas and Georgia, and others fly from larger cities further away.

faqs.q: How much should a Charleston business budget for Google or Meta ads?
faqs.a: It depends on what a booking or customer is worth to you, how many competitors bid on the same searches and how wide an area you cover. We work out a starting budget in a free consultation and quote our management after it.

faqs.q: How soon do paid campaigns bring leads?
faqs.a: That depends on your requirements, the brief and how ready your tracking and landing pages are. We set out the stages and timing in the plan before any money is spent.
